body.condition: The observed reward obeys \(Y_t=\mu_{A_t}(X_t)+\sigma\varepsilon_t\), where \(\varepsilon_t\mid(H_{t-1},X_t,A_t)\sim\mathcal N(0,1)\) and the variables \(\varepsilon_1,\ldots,\varepsilon_T\) are conditionally independent innovations given the realized contexts, assignments, and past observed histories.

standard.name: conditionally independent Gaussian innovation model under adaptive sampling
